basic_details.scholarship_name: Princess Sumaya University for Technology (PSUT) Excellence Scholarship
basic_details.offering_entity: Princess Sumaya University for Technology (PSUT) & Royal Scientific Society (Amman, Jordan)
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: Princess Sumaya University for Technology (PSUT, Amman, Jordan)
basic_details.major_restrictions: Postgraduate programs in King Hussein School of Computing Sciences and King Abdullah II School of Engineering: Computer Science, Data Science, Cybersecurity, Software Engineering, Information Systems Security, Enterprise Systems Engineering, and Electrical Engineering.
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~15 to 25 competitive excellence scholarships and graduate assistantships awarded annually across master's programs
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Open internationally; typically 2 to 4 Pakistani postgraduate students selected per academic year
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: 24 months (2 academic years for standard master's degree)

nationality_requirements: Open to international students of all nationalities, including Pakistan
eligibility_requirements.age_limit_notes: No strict statutory age limit; preference given to candidates under 35 years of age.
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: Recognized 4-year Bachelor's degree (16-year BS / BSc / BE in Computer Science, Software Engineering, IT, or Electrical Engineering) from an HEC-recognized university with high academic standing (minimum CGPA 3.20 / 4.00 or 75%+; rated 'Very Good' or equivalent).
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Minimum undergraduate CGPA 3.20 / 4.00; competitive applicants typically hold CGPA >= 3.50 / 4.00.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or closely related field with strong foundations in algorithms, programming, and mathematics.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Graduated or in final semester of undergraduate degree prior to Fall matriculation.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Professional software engineering, cybersecurity, or data analytics experience strengthens the research proposal and recommendation appraisal.
eligibility_requirements.language_notes: IELTS Academic minimum 6.0, TOEFL iBT minimum 79, or passing the National English Language Exam administered in Jordan. MOI certificates not accepted in lieu of official test scores.
eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: Arabic language proficiency is not required; postgraduate computing and engineering programs are taught 100% in English.
eligibility_requirements.gender_specific_requirements: Open equally to male and female applicants.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Merit-based excellence award evaluating academic record, technical aptitude, and research capacity.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Cannot hold another full institutional scholarship concurrently.

tuition_fee.details: 100% full credit-hour tuition waiver for all required master's courses (worth ~JOD 4,500 to 6,000 per year / ~$6,300 to $8,500).

admission_application_fee.details: Non-refundable application processing fee of JOD 50 (~$70 / ~PKR 20,000) payable to PSUT Admission Office.

accommodation.details: Assistance with private student residences and apartments near the PSUT campus in Al-Jubaiha, Amman; subsidized living costs covered from monthly stipend.

monthly_stipend.details: JOD 250 to 350 / month (~$350 to $500 / ~PKR 100,000 to 140,000 / month) provided as graduate research or teaching assistantship living allowance.

airfare.details: International travel between Pakistan and Queen Alia International Airport (Amman) is self-funded.

visa_fee.details: Jordanian student residence permit fee (~JOD 30-50 / year) facilitated by PSUT International Relations Office.

health_insurance.details: Comprehensive student medical insurance provided through the university health center and affiliated Jordanian medical network.

food_allowance.details: Subsidized campus cafeterias and student dining at PSUT campus.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Full digital access to PSUT Library, IEEE Xplore, ACM Digital Library, and high-performance computing clusters.
books_and_materials_allowance.amount: Full digital library and computing lab access

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Access to King Hussein School computing labs, Royal Scientific Society research facilities, and thesis project support.
research_funding_conference_grant.amount: Full research lab and thesis grant access

travel_transit_allowance.details: Subsidized student transportation cards for Amman Bus transit network.

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Single host university (Princess Sumaya University for Technology - PSUT, Amman, Jordan).
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: Ranked #1 private/specialized university in Jordan and top 800-1000 globally (QS World University Rankings); accredited by ABET; Jordan's premier technological and computing university.
university_and_program_options.program_duration: 2 years (24 months, 33-34 credit hours including master's thesis)
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: HEC-recognized 4-year Bachelor's degree (CGPA >= 3.20/4.00), IELTS 6.0+ or TOEFL 79+, statement of purpose, two letters of recommendation, and passing the departmental interview/admission test.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: Applicants must first gain formal admission to the chosen MSc program through the admission portal, then submit the scholarship application to the Deanship of Admissions and Registration / Graduate Studies.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Align background with PSUT's core strengths in cybersecurity, data science, and AI. Having a strong undergraduate capstone project or conference publication significantly elevates your candidacy for the Excellence Scholarship.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: PSUT Online Admission and Scholarship Portal
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Create an account on the PSUT Admission portal (admission.psut.edu.jo), select postgraduate program, upload HEC-attested degrees, transcripts, English scorecard, CV, and statement of purpose, pay the JOD 50 application fee, and indicate application for the Excellence Scholarship / Graduate Assistantship.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1: Review postgraduate degree offerings and admission criteria on psut.edu.jo.
Step 2: Create an applicant profile on the PSUT online admission portal.
Step 3: Complete personal, educational, and referee details, and upload scanned transcripts, degree certificates, passport, and CV.
Step 4: Upload valid English proficiency test score (IELTS min 6.0 or TOEFL iBT min 79).
Step 5: Pay the non-refundable application fee of JOD 50 online.
Step 6: Submit application before the deadline (June 30 for Fall intake).
Step 7: Attend online departmental technical interview with faculty admissions committee.
Step 8: Upon receiving admission offer, apply for the PSUT Excellence Scholarship / Graduate Assistantship through the Deanship of Graduate Studies.
Step 9: Selection committee reviews academic dossiers and allocates scholarship awards.
Step 10: Receive scholarship award letter, accept offer, and initiate Jordanian student visa processing.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Two-Stage Routing: First secure MSc program admission, then submit scholarship/assistantship application to the Deanship of Graduate Studies.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Two confidential letters of recommendation uploaded through the online admission system or sent directly by referees to graduate admissions.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Statement of purpose (750-1000 words) detailing academic journey, technical background, research objectives in Jordan, and professional aspirations post-graduation.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: 2-3 page preliminary research concept paper outlining proposed master's thesis topic in computing or engineering.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Standard academic CV detailing education, programming proficiencies, project portfolio, GitHub repositories, and publications.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: Online technical and motivational interview (20-30 minutes) conducted in English via Zoom/Microsoft Teams with departmental faculty committee.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Undergraduate degrees and transcripts must be attested by HEC Pakistan, Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MoFA) Pakistan, and Embassy of Jordan in Islamabad upon arrival.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: All academic records and certificates must be in English or accompanied by certified English translations.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: Online submission via PSUT Online Admission Portal.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Recognized 4-year undergraduate degree in Computing, IT, or Engineering with minimum CGPA 3.20 / 4.00.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Attested by HEC and MoFA Pakistan.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Complete consolidated grade transcript covering all undergraduate semesters.
Detailed SOP (750-1000 words) explaining technical background, research interests, and career goals at PSUT.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Highlight alignment with Jordan's tech innovation ecosystem.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Academic appraisals from university professors evaluating technical ability and research promise.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: On official university letterhead with institutional email addresses.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Official IELTS Academic scorecard (min 6.0) or TOEFL iBT (min 79).
Comprehensive CV detailing academic background, technical skills, capstone projects, and GitHub repositories.
2-3 page research concept paper detailing proposed thesis topic and methodology.
High-resolution color copy of passport information page valid for at least 18 months.

important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Fall intake applications open in March and close on June 30; late applications may be considered for self-funded tracks only.

selection_process_and_weights.academic_weight: 40% (Undergraduate CGPA and transcript academic excellence in core subjects)
selection_process_and_weights.research_experience_weight: 20% (Quality of undergraduate thesis/capstone project, research publications, and proposal)
selection_process_and_weights.personal_statement_weight: 10% (Clarity of goals, research vision, and academic motivation)
selection_process_and_weights.interview_weight: 10% (Departmental oral interview assessing technical depth and communication)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: PSUT Deanship of Graduate Studies and Departmental Graduate Admissions Committee.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Multi-criteria weighted rubric evaluating undergraduate academic record, research proposal, and technical interview performance.

competitiveness_profile.total_annual_applicants: ~800 to 1,200 regional and international applicants for postgraduate programs
competitiveness_profile.total_scholarships_awarded: ~15 to 25 full excellence scholarships awarded annually
competitiveness_profile.acceptance_rate_pakistan: ~3.5% to 5.0% among qualified STEM graduates with strong GPAs
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Graduates in computer science, software engineering, or electronics with strong programming portfolios, final-year projects in AI/cybersecurity, and solid mathematical foundations.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Graduates from NUST, FAST-NUCES, COMSATS, UET Lahore, and GIKI.
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: Jordan, Pakistan, Palestine, Egypt, Syria, Iraq, Yemen.

fake_websites_and_scams: Only apply through official PSUT portal https://admission.psut.edu.jo/ and psut.edu.jo.
Beware of unofficial commercial education agencies claiming to sell admissions or scholarships for PSUT.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: Official application fee is JOD 50 payable directly through the university's online payment gateway.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: PSUT does not work with third-party agents or recruitment consultancies; all applications must be submitted directly by the student.
hidden_costs_breakdown: HEC and MoFA document attestations in Pakistan: ~PKR 15,000 - 25,000.
Jordanian Embassy attestation fee in Islamabad: ~PKR 10,000 - 15,000.
misleading_claims_debunked: Myth: You need to know Arabic to study computing at PSUT. Reality: All postgraduate computing and engineering programs are taught 100% in English.
Myth: PSUT provides free flights. Reality: International travel is self-funded by the student.
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Unofficial blogs state MOI certificates are accepted; PSUT requires standard IELTS or TOEFL score reports or passing the Jordanian national English exam.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must maintain a minimum semester CGPA of 3.00 / 4.00 (rated 'Very Good') to retain the scholarship.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Mandatory full-time regular attendance; minimum 80% attendance required in all registered lecture and laboratory modules.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Semester-by-semester academic evaluation by the Deanship of Graduate Studies.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Scholars may work as Graduate Teaching Assistants (GTA) or Graduate Research Assistants (GRA) within PSUT for up to 10-15 hours/week; off-campus employment is restricted under Jordanian student visa regulations.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: None; zero service bond or mandatory home-country return obligation.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.service_obligations_or_bonds: Scholars may be assigned up to 10 hours per week of teaching assistance or research lab support at PSUT.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Revocation of scholarship if semester CGPA drops below 3.00 or in cases of academic dishonesty or code of conduct violations.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_university: Non-transferable to other Jordanian or foreign universities.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Changing degree program requires formal approval from both department heads and the Deanship of Graduate Studies.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Scholarship covers standard 2-year duration (maximum 4 semesters); extensions require exceptional approval.
